config.data: Ten grounded_v1 seen classes; existing expanded20 splits:300 training pool,100 validation,100 historically reused test images.20 images/class for training.Closed-set exploratory pilot.
config.method: Frozen full-image and actual OWL-ViT region features. Seven matched arms. AG:project region plus detector-selected attribute text, pool tokens, then identical two-token global/attribute CAF. Only pooling weights vary:uniform,normalized detector confidence,or reversed confidence among valid regions. Max two regions. Region-only uses zero text and uniform pooling. No auxiliary alignment loss,confidence threshold tuning or new localization. Missing regions fall back to global.
config.training: 200-step visual/random/text initial stage; select by validation macro-F1 then CE. All arms get200 further steps; AG starts from same selected text alignment; matched seed/initialization across AG arms. Same batches/optimizer schedule. Lock all42 checkpoints before scoring test. No test-based selection.
config.statistics: Three-seed accuracy/macro-F1 mean and SD; paired ensemble McNemar and5000 class-stratified bootstrap draws;Holm across six primary comparisons:weighted AG versus uniform AG,text,and shuffled confidence for each backbone.Intervals conditional on fixed models,reused images.
config.limitations: Not exact AG-CLIP replication,not full CLIP pretraining,not zero-shot. CLIP backbone retains language pretraining even with visual head. Same short budget is not optimal tuning. Only2 retained detections;confidence is not calibrated attribute correctness. Data was previously evaluated. No forced positive outcome.
